answer: Attestation weight here is capped at each sparse cut of the social graph. Say agents vouch for a bid to ship ferrous scrap down a river before glacier melt floods the port. A farm of 1,000 fakes linked to honest agents by only 3 edges adds at most 3 units of trust, not 1,000; each extra fake adds zero. A min-cut scan each epoch flags such clusters and slashes their bonds. Colluders behind one cut share one cap, so pooling buys nothing. Densely linked honest users never hit it.
